jobs.title: Investment Strategist
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

This Wealth Advisor Team is seeking an Investment Strategist to lead the investment process for the Team’s clients by developing comprehensive portfolio solutions including the development of strategic asset allocation models and tactical asset allocation recommendations. The Investment Strategist will implement customized investment solutions for the Team’s clients that leverage the institutional capabilities of the Firm’s Investment Strategy Group as well as the institutional knowledge of the Asset Allocation Committee. The Investment Strategist should have a proven track record of developing customized portfolio solutions for clients by utilizing both proprietary and third-party managers, as well as communication views on market outlook broadly. The Investment Strategist must have strong investment expertise and analytic skills, as well as strong communication, presentation and writing skills.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Leveraging the views established by the firm’s institutional asset management leadership to actively contribute to developing strategic and tactical asset allocation recommendations for private wealth clientele

- Driving process and provide investment expertise to build optimal portfolios

- Performing quantitative and qualitative analyses on investments topics; build models when necessary; and contributing to presentations, white papers and articles

- Presenting regularly to existing clients and prospects

Experience & Skills Qualifications:

- A minimum of 8 years of experience constructing portfolios on behalf of HNW clients or institutions

- A comprehensive understanding of asset allocation, portfolio construction and manager selection

- Proven ability to partner with Advisors to present, consult and advise HNW clients to achieve their financial goals

- Keen understanding of the global macro environment, the global economy and other factors that impact the success of investment management strategies

- Superior analytical and problem-solving skills

- Effective verbal and written communication skills

- Embrace and promote a culture of client focus, excellence, integrity and teamwork; effectively encouraging innovation and open dialogue

- Entrepreneurial spirit and strong work ethic

- SIE, Series 7 and 66 licenses are required

jobs.title: Investment Strategist
jobs.description:
Firm Overview:

Neuberger is an independent, employee-owned, global asset management firm, serving the financial needs of intermediary, institutional, and individual investors worldwide. Our broad capabilities include traditional and alternative equity and fixed income strategies, private equity and commodities, in addition to portfolio advice, and wealth planning services. We offer a broad platform to accommodate the evolving needs of our clients.

Business & Position Overview:

Neuberger Wealth oversees approximately $82 billion in assets for individuals, families, and charitable institutions. The Neuberger Wealth Investment Group supports the investment process by contributing to comprehensive portfolio solutions, including strategic asset allocation (SAA) models, tactical asset allocation (TAA) recommendations, portfolio construction, and risk management. The team also produces macro / market research and thought leadership and partners on product and platform development initiatives for the Private Wealth business.

The Vice President, Investment Strategist is a key contributor supporting senior strategists and the broader Neuberger Wealth organization through rigorous analysis, portfolio insights, and client-ready deliverables. The role partners with Wealth Advisors, Portfolio Managers, and the Neuberger Trust Company to help translate market and portfolio views into practical, implementable guidance across public and private markets. Success requires strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly to internal and external audiences.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Support Wealth Advisors in the construction of customized multi-asset portfolio solutions aligned with client objectives, constraints, and implementation considerations. Candidate must have strong understanding of both public and private markets, asset allocation, and portfolio construction

- Evaluate and synthesize client specific information to inform actionable portfolio implications, based on the firm’s Asset Allocation Committee views; create implementation guidance and deliver recommendations to end clients based on the analysis

- Frequent presentations to various client/prospect groups – primarily individuals, families, and select institutions in one-on-one and group settings. Candidate must be willing to travel as needed. Collaborate with resources across Private Wealth to ensure awareness and understanding of solutions across investments, planning, tax, and trust

- Analyze and manipulate data with the goal of creating compelling client-facing and internal content (presentations, market updates, whitepapers, webinar materials, talking points, and training content) with a focus on developing repeatable templates and exhibits while ensuring high standards for accuracy, quality control, and data integrity

- Support team with ad-hoc projects and requests, which will include strategic and training initiatives for the Private Wealth organization

Experience & Skills Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, CFA, and / or other designations preferred

- 7-10+ years’ industry experience required in financial markets, investment research. or wealth management (highly preferred)

- Direct portfolio construction and client experience with high-net-worth clients

- Strong problem-solving skills along with attention to detail

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Team player and willingness to volunteer ideas and create analytical work beyond what is asked

- Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Bloomberg / FactSet

- Series 7 and 66 licenses or ability to obtain

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Private Wealth Product Management
jobs.description:
Business Overview:

The Private Wealth Product Management team serves as the backbone for operational excellence across Private Wealth products and service offerings. The team is responsible for the design, governance, and lifecycle management of all products and investment programs offered to private wealth clients — partnering closely with Product Development, Operations, Legal/Compliance, Technology, CIO, and COO functions to define how products work, who they serve, and how they are controlled.

Position Overview:

This role sits at the core of the Product Management team's design and governance function. You will be responsible for defining the parameters, eligibility rules, and structural guardrails that govern how Private Wealth products and investment programs are built, offered, and administered. This includes translating product and program intent into precise operational and data specifications — from investment product eligibility and fee structures to investment advisory program design and account-level data definitions. This role requires someone who can bridge business intent with operational rigor; equally comfortable designing the rules for a new product launch as they are defining the data architecture that supports it.

Primary Responsibilities:

Product Parameters & Eligibility:
- Define and maintain the rules governing what products and programs can and cannot do; including account eligibility, client eligibility, and offering restrictions

- Establish and document guardrails for new and existing products (e.g., which account types can hold, which client types qualify for a particular strategy, or how fees apply within a given context)

- Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Operations to translate regulatory and policy constraints into clear operational parameters

Investment Program Design & Governance:
- Design and document the operational and data specifications for investment advisory programs and other client-facing programs (e.g., program enrollment criteria, capture and storage associated data that would be required, monitoring parameters, etc.)

- Define program-level data requirements and ensure data attributes are properly structured, labeled, and used consistently across systems and reporting

- Maintain governance artifacts including parameter matrices, eligibility frameworks, decision logs, and program specifications

Cross-Functional Coordination & Controls:
- Serve as a subject matter resource for product and program rules across stakeholder groups including Wealth Advisors, Client Service, Operations, Legal & Compliance, and Data & Technology

- Support product launches by delivering complete and accurate parameter specifications that downstream teams can execute against

- Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or control risks in existing product and program governance; drive resolution and documentation improvements

Experience & Skills Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in financial services, with meaningful exposure to investment products, wealth management, or investment advisory programs

- Bachelor's degree required; or Series 7 & 66 a plus

- Strong working knowledge of investment product structures including mutual funds, ETFs, SMAs, and alternative investments (private funds, hedge fund structures strongly preferred)

- Experience with investment advisory models, fee structures, and regulatory framework (IA vs. BD distinctions)

- Experience defining or working within product eligibility, program governance, or operational rules frameworks

- Demonstrated ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into clear, actionable specifications

- Exceptional attention to detail with strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple workstreams and stakeholders simultaneously in a dynamic environment

- Experience in private wealth, family office, or high-net-worth client service environments

- Familiarity with account data structures, reference data management, or product master

- Background in investment advisory compliance, product governance, or operational risk

- Naturally curious and analytically rigorous — comfortable questions such as "but what happens when…" questions

- Strong judgment and discretion; high level of integrity and professionalism

- Adaptable and energized by building in a growing, evolving team environment

jobs.description:
Summary:

Neuberger is an employee-owned global investment management firm with $613 billion in assets under management. The private investment group of the firm, Neuberger Private Markets, is a leading and growing investor in private markets, managing over $165 billion of client commitments since inception, and over $28 billion of commitments are managed on behalf of Japanese clients including insurance companies, banks and pension funds. Our Japan private markets business has been growing rapidly primarily driven by customized separate account programs diversified across asset classes, investment strategies and geographies. Neuberger is one of the leading players in the private markets custom fund business in Japan and globally.

Our investment strategies include:

- Primary Fund Investments: Invest in private equity funds across asset classes (buyout, special situations, growth equity and venture capital) and geographies (North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America)

- Equity Co-Investments: Invest directly in private companies alongside premier private equity sponsors

- Secondaries: Acquire limited partnership interests in seasoned private equity funds, and structure and execute GP-led secondary transactions

- Private Credit: Invests on a primary or secondary basis in junior and senior private debt instruments, including first and second lien, unitranche, mezzanine and preferred instruments, in profitable and cash-generative private equity-owned companies

Primary Responsibilities:

- Based in the New York headquarters, manage customized separate account programs for Japanese institutional investors, working closely with global investment teams and the client coverage team in the Japan office
- Manage investment planning and portfolio construction as one of the “Japan Coverage team / Japan Desk” members based in New York, including assisting with the production and presentation of materials, organizing and coordinating onsite meetings for Japanese clients

- Liaise with various relevant teams across the firm to prepare responses to RFPs, respond to other prospect /client inquiries and deliver monitoring reports

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst I - Alternative Investments Operations
jobs.description:
We are seeking an analytical, solutions-oriented Business Analyst to join our Alternative Investments Operations team at Neuberger. In this critical role, you will partner with senior operations leaders, product managers, technology teams (including BPM/workflow delivery), and external service providers to drive operational efficiency, streamline business processes, and support the growth of our private equity, private debt, and alternatives platform.

Your work will directly improve end-to-end investment operations through process redesign, automation, and measurable outcomes for internal stakeholders and clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with operations, product, technology, and business teams to assess current-state processes, pain points, controls, and success metrics across the alternative investment lifecycle.

- Map, document, and optimize front-, middle-, and back-office workflows (e.g., swim lanes/BPMN-style where appropriate) to improve clarity, scalability, and auditability.

- Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, exception management, and straight-through processing; define future-state workflows and operating models.

- Partner with workflow/platform teams (e.g., Appian) to define workflow behavior, business rules, routing, SLAs, exception handling, and operational controls/entitlements.

jobs.title: Research Analyst - Non-Investment Grade Credit
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Research Analyst to join our Non-Investment Grade Credit platform. Our goal is to further deepen our research resources and position our team to build upon our long-term track record of performance. We are seeking a candidate with experience in the leveraged credit market. The successful candidate will join a large team of Research Analysts, Traders and Portfolio Managers responsible for managing high yield and leveraged loan assets.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Proactively identify and implement investment ideas across coverage sectors
